title: Exact Athens 2014 Euchologion lead and bounded Greek Catholic myron reception testimony
semantics: Project-created metadata. One exact book lead and one component use report are not a substantive Eucharistic version, normative act, complete book or ancestry. Acquisition/inspection/transcription/collation remain separate.

review_files.packet_role: exact source-evidence manifest; no restricted payload included
review_files.independent_review: accepted corrected bounded source metadata, exact V3 proposals and exact public transport; no blockers

uses.disposition: bounded-progress; exact 2014 book lead with reported myron component use; receiving Eucharistic edition gap remains
uses.supported: 2014 Papadimitriou Euchologion identity, editor-described extent/appendix, and 2019 dated testimony reported in 2024 for one Catholic exarch myron rite.
uses.unresolved: Original title/imprint/approbation, actual Eucharistic pages in use, first adoption, historic sequence and Istanbul implementation.

searches.bounds: Submitted exact aliases and Greek/English/French titles. Results are leads, not source inspection. Selected primary/editor and scholarly sources were then acquired separately. No exhaustive book catalogue or archival search claimed.
searches.negative_result: No public original Greek exarchate approbation, exact Eucharistic book use act, or Greek received 1950/1952 record found in these results.

searches.repertoire: Greek Catholic Exarchate public publication gallery
searches.bounds: All 89 offered book cover JPEGs acquired and visually inspected in 5 labeled contact sheets; pages 2–3 newly acquired, page 1 HTML reused at exact prior hash. Covers only, not interiors or exhaustive publisher production.
searches.negative_result: No exact Eucharistic celebrant book identified among these 89 covers. Catechetical/devotional/Vatican II books are not promoted.

searches.repertoire: Greek Catholic Exarchate public WordPress search API
searches.bounds: 16 literal searches, each per_page=100; returned arrays retained whole. 12 selected post API responses acquired; body read or link/image lead review only. No private/authenticated endpoints.
searches.negative_result: 2018–2019 catecheses discuss received liturgical texts but name no exact Euchologion edition; 2020 Holy Week instruction refers to generic faithful booklets, not a celebrant book. No edition identity inferred from shared prayers.

searches.bounds: Editor interview complete body read; original cover and wedding pp. 198–199 samples visually inspected. 2014 Euchologion full text/front matter and cited myron/Eucharistic pages remain unacquired.
searches.negative_result: No original Catholic approval or completed Eucharistic use tied to the 2014 book established.

searches.bounds: Apothesis public item metadata/rights acquired; download endpoint 401, no account or bypass. Biblionet public response is a login-dependent shell; indexed book metadata not verified from acquired bytes.
searches.negative_result: Neither supplies an inspected original receiving book. Thesis and catalogue interior remain unexamined.

versions.church_scope: Greek Catholic exarch’s reported myron component practice; Greece; separate Istanbul implementation unestablished
versions.date: 2014 publication; 12 May 2019 cited local testimony reported in 2024
versions.date_basis: Chronology positions the 2014 edition publication only; 2019 is the date of testimony cited in 2024 and is not an adoption or first-celebration date.
versions.source_title_status: Original cover title/publisher inspected; original title/imprint/approval leaves uninspected
versions.note: Eusterman’s 2024 study identifies this exact 2014 book and reports use of its appendix myron rite by the Catholic Apostolic Exarch, citing his correspondence with Bishop Manuel Nin dated 12 May 2019. The editor’s 2015 interview independently reports the 2014 release and 840-page extent and the new fuller Patriarchal myron appendix. This narrows the receiving-book lead to an exact edition and one reported component. Catholic approbation, first adoption, exact Eucharistic pages in use, institution-wide reception and separate Istanbul practice remain unestablished. The original cover and wedding sample do not establish physical completeness. Roman 1950 title/1952 printing and Lungro reception remain separate.
